_note: Phase 3.3 seed. "oca" is the OCA Service Book selection (refrain + verses only). HTM-family variants include the split gloryOnly/nowOnly closing doxology per parish practice.

verses: Blessed is the man who has not walked in the counsel of the ungodly.
For the Lord knoweth the way of the righteous, but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice in Him with trembling.
Blessed are all they that put their trust in Him.
Arise, O Lord! Save me, O my God!
Salvation belongeth unto the Lord, and Thy blessing is upon Thy people.
Blessed is the man who hath not walked in the counsel of the impious.
For the Lord knoweth the way of the righteous and the way of the impious shall perish.
Serve ye the Lord in fear and rejoice unto him with trembling.
Blessed are all they that trust in Him.
Arise O Lord, save me O my God.
Salvation is of the Lord, and thy blessing is upon thy people.
value.gloryOnly: Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
value.nowOnly: Both now and ever and unto ages of ages. Amen.
